params.text: Close-miked footsteps of one person in soft rubber-soled sneakers walking slowly on soaked, waterlogged thick office carpet. Each step is a soft muffled thump with a loud wet squelch and squish as water squeezes out of the sodden pile, then a small suck as the foot lifts. No heel click, no wooden knock, no hollow boom. Dry room, no echo, no voices, no music. Silence between steps. Very wet, long squelch.
